design: Same initial Transformer backbone and point head; true two-expert output routing and physical top-pair auxiliary reconstruction
checkpoint_selection: Among complete full-train/full-val epochs: prefer all 8 Res/Trace nonworse than historical Huber+EMD, then minimum mean log W1 ratio; if none eligible, minimum mean 12 log metric ratios. Retain MSE-best separately for historical comparison.
point_scale_convention: MSE=r^2; 2*Huber_delta; 2*s^2*logcosh(r/s), averaged over events and outputs
shape_scale_convention: mean W1 over four standardized marginals OR 32 fixed unit 4D projections; lambda is exploratory, not calibrated between metrics
trace_normalization: Unweighted mean diagonal; truth-row denominators include predictions outside bin range
additional_diagnostics: split each original bin in half
shift interior boundaries by 10% adjacent minimum width, preserve outer edges
limitations: full validation used for checkpoint selection; independent test remains untouched
equal wall-time ceilings; completed epochs/updates may differ
local Trace bin protocol is not yet fully matched to paper
primary checkpoint selection differs from historical MSE rule; export MSE-best separately
loss weights and bounded fixed-scale adaptive family are exploratory, not tuned optima
Additional model capacity and auxiliary supervision vary between baseline and proposed methods; fixed vs learned expert controls routing
Physics consistency covers mass/delta only; auxiliary learning may indirectly affect angular outputs
One initial loss-weight setting; no guarantee all metrics improve

experts.initialization: Two identical copies of base point head; conditional supervision specializes them
experts.shared_aux_losses: Both fixed and learned arms use identical conditional expert losses and router BCE
experts.gate_supervision: unweighted BCE; training labels used only in losses
reported_diagnostics: g conditioned on truth mass region

physics.source: Same hashed training/validation Parquet targets top/antitop px,py,pz,E
physics.statistics: Training split only; logmass std floor0.05
physics.consistency: Direct predicted mass and delta_abs_y vs quantities reconstructed from predicted future-timelike top/antitop vectors

parameters_initialization: Base network seed42 and audited hash; new branch initialization in fork_rng with seed4206
extra_setup_cost: All four arms read and validate the same auxiliary labels, fit training stats; included within22min budget
